cost_basis: GPT-5.5 API list-price equivalent; not Codex subscription billing
native_commands:
/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from werkzeug.routing import Map, Rule
from werkzeug.test import create_environ
from werkzeug.exceptions import NotFound

base = create_environ('/', base_url='http://other.example.org/')

m = Map([Rule('/', endpoint='index')])
a = m.bind_to_environ(base, server_name='example.com')
assert a.subdomain == ''
assert a.match('/') == ('index', {})

m = Map([Rule('/', endpoint='index', subdomain='www')], subdomain_matching=True)
env = create_environ('/', base_url='http://www.example.com/')
a = m.bind_to_environ(env, server_name='example.com')
assert a.subdomain == 'www'
assert a.match('/') == ('index', {})

m = Map([Rule('/', endpoint='index', subdomain='www')])
a = m.bind_to_environ(env, server_name='example.com')
assert a.subdomain == ''
try:
    a.match('/')
except NotFound:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('subdomain rule matched without opt-in')
PY"
